prompt:
Personal settings page (个人设置) inside the admin shell of '擎安智吊 · 吊装安全运营平台' (crane hoisting safety monitoring platform). Desktop 1920x1080, ALL text Simplified Chinese. DARK industrial SCADA style, exact colors: page bg #060d1a with faint cyan 48px grid texture, sidebar #081020, header #0a1526, cards #0d1b30, inner blocks #122340, borders #1e3a5c, text #e8f1fd / #8ba3c2 / #55708f, brand blue #3b82f6, cyan accent #22d3ee, danger #ef4444, success #22c55e. Font Noto Sans SC.

LEFT SIDEBAR (232px, #081020): top brand row with small navy shield badge logo with gold crane hook, '擎安智吊' (17px white letter-spaced) over '吊装安全运营平台' (10px muted). Below, vertical menu items with icons: 工作台, 台账管理, 吊车管理, 摄像头管理, 录像机管理, 音柱管理, 电子围栏, 安全报表, 违章类型, 基础配置, 审计日志; active item '个人设置' highlighted with horizontal blue gradient background and a 2px cyan left inset bar. Bottom: user card (rounded panel) with circular blue avatar '安', name '安全管理员', role '系统管理员'.

TOP HEADER (60px, #0a1526, bottom border): left breadcrumb '个人中心 / 个人设置' (last part white bold). Right actions: cyan outlined chip '📍 华东能源基地 / 2#作业区', bell icon with red dot, a sun/moon day-night toggle icon button, then circular blue avatar '安'. Below the avatar an OPEN dropdown menu (floating panel #122340, border, shadow) showing header '安全管理员 / admin@qingan.com', item '⚙ 个人设置', divider, item '⏻ 退出登录' in red #ef4444.

MAIN CONTENT (max-width 900px centered, vertical stack of cards, each card #0d1b30 with 1px #1e3a5c border, 10px radius, card title with a small vertical blue-to-cyan gradient bar):
1. Profile card: large 72px circular blue gradient avatar '安' with small camera badge, name '安全管理员' + cyan pill tag '系统管理员', meta line 'admin@qingan.com · 上次登录 2026-07-21 08:42 · IP 192.168.1.10', right-aligned outlined blue button '编辑资料'.
2. Card '外观偏好': row '主题模式 / 选择日间、夜间或跟随系统' with three selectable preview cards (夜间模式 selected with blue ring showing dark navy preview, 日间模式 light preview, 跟随系统 half-half preview); row '侧边栏默认收起' with toggle switch off.
3. Card '通知偏好': three rows with toggle switches — '风险事件告警 / 发生高危风险事件时站内推送提醒' (on, blue), '设备离线提醒 / 吊车、摄像头等设备心跳异常时提醒' (on), '审批待办提醒 / 有新的审批待办时提醒' (off).
4. Card '常规设置': row '默认落地页 / 登录后默认进入的页面' with select dropdown showing '工作台'; row '登录密码 / 建议定期更换密码以保障账号安全' with outlined button '修改密码'.
